_note: Tier 2, oldest end. 16-23 September 2025: the Canada oil press, the Netanyahu attempt, the five shakings.

mentions.claim_text: Speaking prophetically to Canada he says the church should rise up, that there are dark days for the land but light days for the church.
mentions.quote: dark days for the land, but light days for the church
mentions.falsify_match: Hardship for Canada alongside growth in its churches.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Both halves lack a measure, and the pairing means either outcome can be read as confirmation.

mentions.claim_text: He says the body of Christ in Canada will come out better and stronger than ever, and that an oil press is coming with darkness and financial trouble.
mentions.quote: It is an oil press coming. I see darkness, financial things
mentions.falsify_match: Canadian financial hardship followed by church growth.

mentions.claim_text: He says there will be a squeeze but the church will be better than it has ever been, acknowledging it is not a word people want to hear.
mentions.quote: that might not be some tickly word that you would like to hear
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a restatement with an acknowledgement that it is unwelcome.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has just seen what is coming against Israel and these nations in the storm, and repercussions for their decisions.
mentions.quote: what will happen in repercussion for their decisions
mentions.falsify_match: Consequences falling on states that acted against Israel.
mentions.falsify_miss: None attributable. The nations are not named here.

mentions.claim_text: He says British Columbia is something of biblical proportions, that he saw a volcano out in the ocean explode, and dead fish everywhere, which he says was literal.
mentions.quote: I saw the volcano out in the ocean explode
mentions.falsify_match: A submarine volcanic eruption off British Columbia with a mass fish kill.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He states the fish are literal rather than symbolic, which narrows it usefully.

mentions.claim_text: He says it reaches into Anchorage and that area, that this is not a normal earthquake but a massive event he saw again that night, and that persecution comes on the church in Canada.
mentions.quote: This is not just a normal earthquake. This is a massive event
mentions.falsify_match: A great earthquake reaching from British Columbia into Anchorage.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Two named places on the same margin.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is not political but a Jesus person who loves the Lord, and asks whether the audience watched the funeral that day.
mentions.quote: I am not political. I am a Jesus person
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a statement of his own position.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls the word that a shaking was coming to the Catholic Church and the word about an Asian man who would rise up, and says an article discusses the Catholic Church trying to reach out.
mentions.quote: just like I gave the word about the Asian man that would rise up
mentions.falsify_match: An Asian figure rising in the Catholic Church.
mentions.falsify_miss: None has. He offers an article about outreach as the confirmation.

mentions.claim_text: He says he knew in the spirit realm that a major thing would happen that day and it did, at the funeral, with people awakening.
mentions.quote: a major thing will happen today. And it did
mentions.falsify_match: A major event on 21 September 2025, the date of the memorial he refers to.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The event was scheduled and publicised well in advance, so knowing it was coming required no vision.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts the Passover instruction to put the blood on the doorpost so the destroyer would pass over the firstborn.
mentions.quote: put the blood upon your doorpost
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: Exodus 12 recounted.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts being corrected about the power of his tongue and told his eyes would be opened to something while he interceded.
mentions.quote: Watch what you are saying. I want to open your eyes
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: personal correction.

mentions.claim_text: He says God is not angry and not conspiring against people, rejecting the idea that he looks for ways to strike them.
mentions.quote: God is not angry. God is not conspiring against you
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a theological position, and one that sits against the judgment material elsewhere.

mentions.claim_text: He discusses camera and battery quality with someone off screen, noting the camera is now 24 megapixels.
mentions.quote: your camera is better, it is 24 megapixels now
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: production chatter.

mentions.claim_text: He says bad men influence financial decisions and that nothing will stop the boat going over the edge concerning the United States, though it can be delayed.
mentions.quote: nothing is going to stop the boat from going over the edge
mentions.falsify_match: An American financial collapse.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. This is the delay-not-stop rule applied to the economy: the event is inevitable, so no date can fail.

mentions.claim_text: He names Gabriel concerning Israel and the decision in the days ahead, and prays over England and the United Kingdom and their decision.
mentions.quote: England, the United Kingdom praying over their decision
mentions.falsify_match: A British decision on Israel. The United Kingdom recognised Palestinian statehood on 21 September 2025, two days after this.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees Israel, sees the week of the 23rd again, and sees England and the prime minister of England.
mentions.quote: I see the week of the 23rd again and I see England
mentions.falsify_match: A British move on Israel in the week of 23 September 2025. The UK recognised Palestine on 21 September, two days before that week began.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such move. The UNGA high-level week of 23 September was on the published calendar.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are seated far above all principalities and powers, and that taking their place of authority will stop more and more things like this.
mentions.quote: if we take our place of authority, we will stop more of these things
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: the diversion premise stated again.

mentions.claim_text: He restates the month to remember and a great acceleration, says to watch the fig tree which is Israel, and points to a major speech going forth.
mentions.quote: month to remember, a great acceleration. Watch the fig tree
mentions.falsify_match: A month of decisive events in September 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: An ordinary month. Scored under september-2025-acceleration.

mentions.claim_text: He uses the Batman signal as an image of an alert that brings help, and says they need that.
mentions.quote: Batman symbol went up. We need Batman, right?
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an illustration.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Mahdi is not on the scene yet in the sense they see, that the Ishmael tills the ground and is getting it ready for the Antichrist to take over.
mentions.quote: He will till the ground. He is getting it ready
mentions.falsify_match: A forerunner figure preparing the way for the Antichrist.
mentions.falsify_miss: None identifiable. Saying he is not on the scene yet removes any deadline.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is what the Lord is warning about and that they can stop it, and that watching out of Germany he saw an attempt on the Israeli prime minister in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: I saw an attempt on Ben
mentions.falsify_match: An assassination attempt on the Israeli prime minister.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A named individual and a named act, which makes this one of the more checkable security claims.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was praying over Israel government making the right choices because of the antisemitism that will rise in the days ahead when they see the week of the 23rd.
mentions.quote: anti-semitism that will rise up in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A rise in antisemitic incidents around the week of 23 September 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: No rise. Antisemitic incident counts are published annually, which makes this checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw witchcraft and an actual human being sacrificed, everything demonic, done to conjure up a Hitler spirit.
mentions.quote: They were sacrificing a human. It was demonic
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a ritual killing with no place, date or victim named.

mentions.claim_text: He says revival will hit the Catholic Church in a way never seen, and reports the Lord saying he is going to visit the Catholic people.
mentions.quote: I am going to visit the Catholic people
mentions.falsify_match: A revival movement inside the Catholic Church.

mentions.claim_text: He urges people to keep hitting it until it does not exist any more and to believe bigger.
mentions.quote: you keep hitting it until it does not exist anymore
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: exhortation.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls being told about five levels of shaking, and that not everyone will experience the same one, with some being political.
mentions.quote: remember what I told you, five levels of shaking
mentions.falsify_match: Five distinguishable domains of upheaval.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Saying not everyone experiences the same one means no individual absence counts against it.

mentions.claim_text: He says things became lit with fire and started burning and he saw trouble coming to America, and recalls hearing the angels about decisions and antisemitism.
mentions.quote: I saw trouble coming to America
mentions.falsify_match: Serious disorder in America tied to decisions on Israel.

mentions.claim_text: He says the gospel must be preached to all the nations as a witness and then the end will come, naming North Korea, China and Asia.
mentions.quote: the gospel must be preached to all the nations as a witness
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: Matthew 24:14 applied as the precondition for the return.

mentions.claim_text: He says the spots where he told them revival would spring forth in America are all praying churches and praying people who seek God.
mentions.quote: they are all praying churches. They are all praying people
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an observation about the places already named.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told to remember the janitor and the mess in the plastic glove no matter how big the platform gets.
mentions.quote: remember the janitor. Remember the poo in the plastic glove
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a personal instruction about humility.
